questions.answer: Per this site's FAQ, SEO is a long-term investment, and timelines depend on your starting point, competition, and goals. Technical fixes and quick wins can show impact within weeks, meaningful organic traffic growth typically appears between three and six months, and substantial, compounding results often show at six to twelve months [1]. AI visibility (AEO and GEO) can shift faster, since these platforms update their knowledge bases [1]. Joe sets expectations based on each situation, and for a timeline tailored to your site, you can visit the contact page at /contact/ [1].
